A flower inspires a winter sports torch.

Changchun has shown the medals, torch and uniforms for its twenty twenty-seven winter university games. The designs appeared on Wednesday at an event marking a hundred days before the games. The city is using local ideas to tell a story through these objects.

The torch's shape was inspired by a flower connected with Changchun. Near the top, its design includes pictures of twelve winter sports. A pattern like a strip of film also refers to the city's film industry. Other details include snowflakes and lines inspired by skiing.

The torch is seven hundred and eleven millimeters tall. This number refers to the highest point in the city's urban area, which is seven hundred and eleven meters high. The design connects winter sport with flowers, films and the landscape around the city.
